HTCU.craft_notes: Readable conventional serif lockups and appealing palette, but standalone mark clipping needs correction before release.
HTCU.revision_notes: Business renamed consistently in visible lockups and sheet; new tagline has correct middle dots but incorrect uppercase styling. Shape-only icon appearance retained; no unrelated redesign.

Logo sheet does not show the app icon on both backgrounds.

defects.what: Flame and side beams merge into a face-like cluster at 16 px; a simplified small-size drawing would help.

VTCH.craft_notes: Strong compact badge and warm wordmark; clean outlined vectors and coherent reverse variants.
VTCH.revision_notes: Both lockups and sheet show Tidewick & Co. and the new tagline, but tagline is all capitals rather than Coffee · Bakery · Harbor. Symbol-only assets appropriately retain their appearance.

pairwise_round1.why: VTCH delivers a cleaner contained mark without HTCU's clipped standalone waves and sheet labels.
